_notes: Column mappings use Excel column letters. Negatives are preserved as-is.

RAC._notes: AF=SPLIT TO AGENT (PayDiverse share). File in Breier/ subfolder each month. Negatives from chargebacks must be preserved.

USAG._notes: Col L = ResidualDueOffice. May 2026+ format uses L/BF/BJ. Older format (Jan-Apr) may use AJ.

Maverick._notes: AQ=Agent Payout (Aug 2026+ format; older months used AP). Files in Breier subfolder.

PayArc._notes: M=Agent income (formatted as '$ 21.46'). C=MID, B=Merchant name. Values with $ prefix handled by f() parser.

Netevia._notes: Col D header is agent name (e.g. 'Frank Sena') but always column D. Negatives = chargebacks. File in root month folder (not Breier subfolder).

Total-Apps._notes: H=ISO $ Split = PayDiverse's share as ISO. File in Breier subfolder.

Payment Cloud._notes: O=Partner Comm = PayDiverse's commission as partner. Rows without MID in col E are skipped.

Taluspay._notes: W = final agent/reseller payout (last column). No header row — data starts at row 1.

Finns._notes: J=Net Agent (ELM) = PayDiverse 65% share. K=Finns 35% share. Last few rows are blank-merchant summary rows — skip them via skip_blank_mid.

HiRisk._notes: B=Commission Due. 4 preamble rows before data. No gross volume column. Single MID per report.

Cardworks._notes: J=Residual (Income minus Expense = net PayDiverse earns).

Expitrans._notes: K=NetProfit (total net before agent split). G=volume formatted as dollar string.

E-Fitness Today._notes: H=Commission (summary row only, not per-campaign row). Single-merchant campaign-level report.

Merchant Industry._notes: K=Net (Income-Expense). Data on sheet 'Agent Main Data'. Skip rows with no MID in col A.

Revitpay._notes: M=Agent Net (70% of net). 6 title/metadata rows before header. Data starts at row 7.

Midmetrics._notes: Custom grouped summary parser (parse_midmetrics_rows). Sums col E per merchant across all sections. One record per sub-merchant (midmetrics_XXX).

Seamless Chex._notes: M=Payout Total (agent net). 4 summary rows before header. Data starts at row 6.

Payliance._notes: E=CommissionsAmount. Row 0=metadata, Row 1=header, data from row 2.

AltoPay._notes: Block-per-merchant layout. Row "Merchant: {name}" starts each block. Agent payout in col C of row where col B = "Agent".

NMI._notes: Q=Total Commission (Aug 2026+ format; older months used R). B=Gateway ID (MID), C=Merchant. File in Breier subfolder.

GET._notes: AL=CommissionAmount. J=TotalVolumeSales. A=MID, B=DBAName. File has a yellow Total row at bottom with no MID — skip it. Pattern uses lowercase Get (avoid matching July copy).

Celero._notes: L=Payout (agent payout = PayDiverse income). H=TotalVolume. File in Breier subfolder.

Authorize.Net._notes: N=Residual Amount. A=Payment Gateway ID (MID), B=Reference ID (name). File in Breier subfolder.

MerchantE Synovous._notes: L=Net P/L (net profit/loss after all expenses). A=Organization (DBA), B=Org Id (MID). File in Breier subfolder.

First Direct Financial._notes: M=Agent Net (PayDiverse payout). 7 rows before data (6 blank/title + 1 header). File in Breier subfolder.

Nuvei._notes: CQ=Agent Net (PayDiverse share). A=MID, B=DBA Name (trimmed), I=V/MC/Discover Volume. Skip last row (Total row where A='Total'). File is legacy binary .xls format — convert via Google Drive (copy to Sheets, export as xlsx) before running import.

CC Bill._notes: L=Partner Commission. F=Merchant Account ID, I=Company Name, E=Billing Period (Excel serial date). File is cumulative weekly — skip_header_rows=5 skips metadata; date filter selects only rows matching report month.

Worldpay (Vantiv)._notes: Y=TOTAL_ADJ_RESID (net adjusted residual). L=MERCH_NBR (MID), O=MERCHANT_NAME, R=TOTAL_SALES_VOLUME. File in Breier subfolder.

Nexio._notes: N=Agent Residual. F=MID (numeric 15-digit). G=Merchant Name. Legacy binary .xls file — parsed via xlrd. File is at root month folder (not Breier subfolder).

SignaPay._notes: M=Net (ISO net after agent payout). A=MID, B=DBA. File in /Signapay/ subfolder within month folder. Aug 2026 file: ISOMerchantsResiduals.2026.08.xlsx.

payment_due_rules._note: Days after month end (always 30th, or Feb 28). Use '5th_next' for 5th of following month.
